title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me with the keystone to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, who keep what is left of Kothringi lore. I'm to show it to their elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.
objectives: Show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: The keystone from the wreck is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers' elder may know what it opens.
plan.next: Take boats to Lujei Ferry, cross to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye, and the keystone may matter to that.
Show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers, Hums-the-Long-Note, in the Kothringi Greathouse in Toklea.
I can go through the Greathouse door and talk to Hums-the-Long-Note quietly. I could also look around Toklea first. No other choice is visible yet.
I do not know what the Eye is exactly, or what the keystone does. I hope the elder can tell me.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone, and named her price: her family's carved grave-stake lies in a chest in the drowned street of Zul-Etha, and she wants it raised. Crocodiles lie on the roof peaks above it. I may kill them from a roof or from range, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen to the chest.
objectives: Raise the grave-stake from the chest in Zul-Etha's drowned street. (marker: Drowned Chest)

plan.going: The elder will say what the keystone opens if I raise her family's grave-stake.
plan.next: Go to Zul-Etha and take the grave-stake from the chest under the water.
plan.ways: Kill the crocodiles (from a roof or from range), calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen.
terms: Zul-Etha: Hums-the-Long-Note: a carting village the washes drowned, south-east of Mir-Xal

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment: her family grave-stake from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha.
Go to Zul-Etha (south-east of Mir-Xal quay) and raise the grave-stake from the chest.
Crocodiles and an old bull sit on the roof peaks: kill them from a roof or range, calm them with Illusion, or swim under unseen. As a quiet character, swimming under or calming suits me.
I do not know where exactly Mir-Xal quay is, though the marker should guide me. I still do not know what the keystone is.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note took her family's stake and kept her word: the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin near Gideon. The Kothringi knights of Gideon were the last to guard the kings' road to the Root. I'm to tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom what the keystone opens. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike, on the old road to the Root.
terms: Eurydike and the knights of Gideon: Hums-the-Long-Note: the hall of Kothringi knights who served in Gideon's garrison and guarded the kings' road to the Root

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note took the stake and told me the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall north of Gideon. The Kothringi knights of Gideon guarded the old kings road to the Root.
Report to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go to Nesh-Deeka now. Later I could go to Eurydike myself, but the journal says to tell Nesh-Deeka.
I do not know what the Root is, or how the Eye connects to the tomb. Nesh-Deeka or more research may tell me.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard me out. She already knew that the Unbound have been asking Gideon's diggers about Eurydike. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and told me to hurry. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The Unbound are close behind on the same trail; Nesh-Deeka knows it and will not say how.
plan.next: MN09 starts; its first entry marks Eurydike.

answers: The quest is done. The keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike, near Gideon, a step toward the Eye of Argonia at the Root. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold and says the Unbound are already asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike.
Hurry to Eurydike, north of Gideon, with the keystone. No marker yet.
Go to Eurydike directly, or ask Nesh-Deeka more first.
I still do not know exactly what the Eye of Argonia or the Root is, or how Nesh-Deeka listens.
